CustomField.label: Severity Rank
CustomField.description: Worst-first sort key for Severity__c (Critical=0, Warning=1, Good=2) — a plain alphabetical ORDER BY on Severity__c would incorrectly sort Good before Warning. Used only by the Remediation Management workspace's queue query (OI_OrgHealthFindingRepository.getFindingsByFilter); not persisted, recomputed per query.
